name: Animal Policy International
summary: Works with governments so that imported animal products meet the same welfare standards as domestic ones, in New Zealand, the UK and the EU.

spending.source: EU Transparency Register entry of MTÜ Animal Policy International (0491253100612-09), via LobbyFacts, https://www.lobbyfacts.eu/datacard/animal-policy-international?rid=0491253100612-09: "Total organisational budget in closed year 120,000€" (Jan to Dec 2025); in dollars at the 2025 rate (facts: fx.usd_per_eur_2025), times our judged whole-organisation ratio (1.3) and programme share (85%), rounded; no accounts are published

lines.label: Research and advocacy for welfare standards on imported animal products (EU, UK, New Zealand)
